TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANT TOSECTION81-642 OF THEZONINGRESOLUTION OF THECITY OFNEWYORK This Transfer and Distribution of Development Rights Instrument (*"Transfer and Distribution Instrument") is made as of the 4th day of December, 2018, by and between Midtown GCT Ventures LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with an address at c/o MSD Partners, L.P.,645 Fifth Avenue, 21st Floor,New York, New York ("Transferor"), and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., a national banking association, with an office at 237 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10016 ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, pursuant to Sections 81-642 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"), the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission of the City of New York (the “CPC Chairperson") shall allow, by certification, the distribution of Floor Area that is generated by a “granting lot" located in theEast Midtown Subdistrict (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Resolution) to a “"receiving lot" located in one or more subareas other than the Vanderbilt Corridor Subarea of the East Midtown Subdistrict of the Special Midtown District (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Resolution), which distribution of floor area shall not exceed a maximum of 666,766 square feet on such receiving lot; and WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of 1,285,010 sf of unused and unallocated floor area development rights appurtenant to that certain real property located in the County, City and State of New York, designated as Block 1280, Lots 1, 54 and 154 on the Tax Map of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit I attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Granting Lot"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the fee owner of that certain real property located in the County, City and State of New York, designated as Block 1283, Lot 21 on the Tax Map of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit II attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Receiving Lot"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot is located in a C5-3 zoning district and within the Grand Central Transit Improvement Zone Subarea of the East Midtown Subdistrict; and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot is a “granting lot,” as defined in Section 81-613 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, the maximum amount of Floor Area that may be transferred from a granting lot shall be the applicable basic maximum Floor Area as set forth in Section 81- 64 of the Zoning Resolution, less the total Floor Area of all existing buildings on the zoning lot, and any previously transferred Floor Area;
